properties.notes: Site occupied by garage showroom and forecourt, Quaker meeting house, public toilets and scrubland. Due to the current uses, the site is not available but could be in the long-term. It has been indicated that the land could be available for redevelopment in the future, this could be in whole or in part . This would be dependent on the need and ability to secure alternative sites for relocation.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
